error: Settle disagreement: CNBC-derived sources, tradingeconomics (previous close), straits.live and the Reuters Monday copy all give Brent 98.32 / WTI 90.83 for Fri 2026-11-06, while cappnotes prints ~97.79 / ~90.37 and the repo Yahoo series 97.76 / 90.34 - about 0.5 USD lower on both; both sets recorded, not reconciled. No source named contract months and no Brent second-month settle was found (value null); only MUFG's 5 Nov 'under USD 2.50/b' prompt spread. No Dated Brent / Dubai / EFS quote (Reuters physical item paywalled, date unconfirmed). Weekly Brent decline is printed variously as 12.5%, 13.3%, 16% and 17%. Transit measures conflict by an order of magnitude (PortWatch 1/day on 1 Nov; hormuz.now 3.1 AIS tankers/day; Windward 14 in 48h; UKMTO 325/week; ~31/day via Gulf News) - different definitions, none divided or reconciled. No current Hormuz mb/d flow figure (latest Kpler print is week to 29 Sep). War-risk % of hull: only an October 6-10% range, no November quote. UKMTO since-5-Nov count is a tally of press reports, not an official figure; UKMTO PDF, CENTCOM release, CNBC (3 URLs), straits.live 11-09 brief, invezz, Lloyd's List and US News were unreachable. Several sources (houseofsaud, straits.live, hormuz.now, financefeeds) are aggregators quoting others. Source weekday/date mismatches: Al Jazeera 8 Nov calls 7 Nov both Friday and Saturday; Qeshm strike night is 6 Nov per Al Jazeera 7 Nov. Mine-strike claims are IRGC-only and unconfirmed. Israel Hayom deal-terms report is single-sourced. No in-gate hits for Wang Yi/China, Qatar LNG status change, mine-clearance operations, or OFAC licenses/waivers.
